column1: # Every (reporter_standard, spelling) pair cite-detector-moml builds a
# single-volume detector from, snapshotted read-only from the live database on
# 2026-09-06 with the query in DBStore.GetSingleVolReporterAbbrs. Tab separated:
# reporter_standard, then the spelling the detector is built from.
# The prefilter tests run the real abbreviations, not invented ones, because the
# literal gate has to hold for the shapes the corpus actually contains --
# parentheses, ampersands, embedded periods, one-character segments. Refresh it
# when legalhist.reporters or reporters_abbreviations changes; nothing outside
